## Code

Code will look like this:

```python
print("Hello, World!")
```

## Diagrams

Diagrams will look like this

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A --> C
  B --> C
  C --> D
```
## Data 

You can embed tables, for example here [Palmer Penguins](data/palmer-penguins.csv) dataset:

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
//| code-copy: false
data = FileAttachment("data/palmer-penguins.csv").csv({ typed: true })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| code-copy: false
Inputs.table(data)
```

## Diataxis

A method for writing documentation: [Diataxis](diataxis).

[diataxis]: https://diataxis.fr/start-here/#the-four-kinds-of-documentation

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"quadrantChart": {"chartWidth": 440, "chartHeight": 220, "titleFontSize": 16, "quadrantLabelFontSize": 14, "xAxisLabelFontSize": 13, "yAxisLabelFontSize": 13}}}%%
quadrantChart
    x-axis Acquisition --> Application
    y-axis Cognition --> Action

    quadrant-1 How-to guides
    quadrant-2 Tutorials
    quadrant-3 Explanation
    quadrant-4 Reference
```
